scope: Human-only post-training cytokine-held-out groups within released B-cell evaluation context; known donors; anonymous native features.
method: Released State native primary-energy supervised continuation plus deterministic frozen-reference prediction-MSE anchoring.
selection: Minimum calibration cytokine-macro native energy; exact ties prefer smaller lambda.

data_manifest.selection_rule: first up to64 original row positions for every cytokine/PBS ×donor; metadata only, no loss or predicted values inspected
data_manifest.feature_contract: unchanged same-release2000 numeric feature order; no gene symbol mapping inferred; original export copies pert_cell_emb and clips0..14
data_manifest.scope: human B_Intermediate_Memory original fewshot test62cytokines plus defaulttrainPBS; cytokines seen in other training celltypes; not globally unseen perturbations or crossspecies
data_manifest.split_rule: new adaptation/calibration/test assignment external and frozen by metadata only before loss access; group bycytokine, preserve donor populations

limitations: Condition groups, not cells or coordinates, define held-out tasks.
PBS populations and donors are shared across roles.
Model set size differs from original training size512.
Primary native energy is a finite-population V-statistic; energy U/MMD U are secondary and may be negative.
One optimization seed and few held-out cytokines; this is a technical human-context benchmark.
